C-CI-CD-AUDIT-FIXES.Name: Close six confirmed CI/CD audit gaps
C-CI-CD-AUDIT-FIXES.Summary: Make unsigned QA builds usable and fail closed, restore the broken docs-only classification, gate IPC types before integration, pin CI executables, remove duplicate WebKit work, and bind rare owner-run gateway deploys to a checked main commit.
C-CI-CD-AUDIT-FIXES.ApprovalBasis: The owner supplied the six-finding audit and instructed the agent to decide the approach and do the work on 2026-11-09.

Goals.Goal: Unsigned manual builds run without production signing secrets and stop at the first failed verification command on both supported platforms.
The required PR status includes IPC type checking and each WebKit project executes once.
Documentation-only classification has a checkout and read permission, and never skips tests for mixed code/documentation changes.
Local work, CI, dry-run and production packaging select one exact Rust version and executable Actions references are immutable.
Owner-run gateway deploys require a clean, checked exact main SHA and record deployment identity and route checks.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve release owner approvals, tag-only production signing, required status names, and the owner-executed Worker deployment model.
Keep production signing credentials out of the manual QA job.
Repair the pre-existing module-map mismatch that blocks baseline GRACE lint, without changing its test behavior.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No release version, tag, publication, live Worker deploy, mobile delivery, or dependency lockfile change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Workflow structure and focused tests prove unsigned QA packaging, fail-fast checks, accurate docs-only classification, IPC gating, immutable Actions references and no duplicate WebKit projects.
Worker deploy preflight refuses dirty, non-main and unverified candidates before invoking Wrangler, and the runbook records SHA, Worker version and post-deploy route checks.
GRACE final assertions and current-state lint pass after the change is archived.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-046 release and CI workflows, M-071 gateway deployment procedure, V-M-046 and V-M-071 verification, and one unrelated baseline test map repair.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Focused local command results, structural workflow assertions, preflight refusal tests and GRACE target/final/current results; hosted macOS and Windows QA builds remain external follow-up evidence.
